_about: Hand-kept sidecar for docs/v2.1-ability-canon.md (closure table CL-104). The generator (tools/generate-ability-canon.py) joins it to the compiled catalog and FAILS on a missing or unknown key, so every new, renamed or retired card forces an entry here. Keys: card id, or 'syn:<Tree>_<3|5|7>'. Describe CURRENT behaviour; rulings not yet built go in 'sensitivities' as 'A7b: …'.

Fire.thesis: Burning and big booms, with a real risk/reward dial.

Shock.thesis: LOUD, bombastic, chaining wackiness — 'wackiness is how we'll be remembered.'

Bleed.thesis: Wounds that keep taking: Bleed ticks, executes and blood sustain, rewarding kills on already-bleeding foes.
Bleed.source: working summary (Claude) — for Lyra to confirm

Guard.thesis: Hold your ground and the ground hits back: two survival layers, mitigation, and retaliation.
Guard.source: working summary (Claude, from Q-G1 and the A5 commit) — for Lyra to confirm

Void.thesis: Everything falls in, and some of it comes back: wells, erasure and fear that ignore the usual rules.
Void.source: working summary (Claude, from the A6 commit) — for Lyra to confirm

Growth.thesis: Growth modifies the ARENA rather than Spark: cultivated ground, living structures, territory. Verb: Cultivate.
Growth.source: Brandon + Lyra (v2.0 Phase C); untouched in v2.1

Neutral.thesis: Not a tree: the palette's constant. Stat, XP and utility picks, never gated. Redesign deferred to v2.2+.

bleed_1.hitClass: Stat only: +10%/+20% crit chance (totals); crit is rolled at fire for every fireProjectile shot (fragments, Iceburst shards and echoes too) and for the Polar Vortex icicle, never for the icicle's own shards (A7b S9, CL-117), and per target on sweeps.
bleed_1.bossClass: Crits land on gun and sweep boss hits too.
bleed_1.sensitivities: The only in-pool crit source (base crit 0%), so it provides `.critSource` for Hemorrhage (CL-91, A7a); Glass Blood fragments, returned shots, Shadow Edge and the icicle's own shards never crit. A7b S9 (CL-110/117): the Polar Vortex replacement icicle rolls crit like the primary shot it replaces and counts once toward Calculated Strike, so Gouge and Hemorrhage keep working after T4.

bleed_2.hitClass: Stat only: +1.0 crit-damage multiplier (2× → 3×, keeping Forge Path Deadeye); a crit deals max(2, Int(damage × multiplier)).
bleed_2.sensitivities: A dead pick without a crit source — CL-91 makes it require `.critSource` (A7a). A7b S9 (CL-110/117): the Polar Vortex icicle now crits (a crit icicle at base deals 4, 6 with Hemorrhage), so Hemorrhage keeps paying after T4.

bleed_3.hitClass: Stat only: a full-credit kill of an already-bleeding enemy grants +15% real fire rate for 4s; further qualifying kills reset it, never stack or extend.
bleed_3.bossClass: A boss kill qualifies if the boss was bleeding before the killing damage (CL-29).
bleed_3.tell: HUD ATK SPD row shows the live rate (CL-24).
bleed_3.sensitivities: Reward-only kills (bursts, Everglow, Static Crown, Inferno Crown) never qualify; it also speeds Red Smile swings.

bleed_4.hitClass: Stat only: heal 1/2/4/5 HP (totals) on each full-credit kill; with Sanguinarian only Siphon's overheal becomes Blood Barrier, 1:1.
bleed_4.bossClass: A boss kill heals once through the chokepoint (CL-29).
bleed_4.tell: None dedicated (HP just rises; no heal flash on this path).
bleed_4.sensitivities: At full HP, Siphon T4 + Sanguinarian fill a 50-point barrier in nine kills (A4b gate note); reward-only kills never heal.

cap_bleed_apex.geometry: The bat orbits Spark and bites without any occlusion test (Ruling 1 'Apex-style' pass), and the pounce likewise.
cap_bleed_apex.targeting: Bites every 1.5s at the nearest enemy (then the boss) within 0.6×arena radius; T3 prefers the nearest bleeding target incl. a bleeding boss by surface; the T5 gauge fills from gun hits on enemies and the arena boss, bat bites and Red Smile contacts (0.2s rate limit), and the pounce takes the nearest executable target.
cap_bleed_apex.hitClass: Summon %ATK bite (10% ATK, +1% per 5 bat kills to 50%) with 50% lifesteal; T2 +5 max HP per 10 kills and 1% max HP → ATK, T3 executes normals <20%, T4 Marked +35% taken (foes after 10s alive, the arena boss at once), T5 a 4-hit gauge → execute.
cap_bleed_apex.bossClass: Bites at damageScale 50% on boss-class; Marked is +17.5% on boss-class and lands on the arena boss immediately; the pounce executes mini-bosses and bosses only at ≤10% HP.
cap_bleed_apex.tell: Crimson 0xC02040 bat with yellow eyes, a pulsing 0xE0304D target ring, 0x99304D Marked pulses, blood-mist executes, a 4-pip gauge, and horns/fangs/wings on Spark at T5 (v1.9 procedural FX).
cap_bleed_apex.sensitivities: On gun and sweep hits Marked folds into the one direct-hit rounding (a 1-damage hit on a Marked foe averages 1.35; CL-114, A7b S8), and every other source still rounds it in-node. Marked is its own vulnerability channel (CL-107, A7b S6): the strongest active of Frostbite, Marked, Called and Fracture applies, never stacked, and each source clears only itself; Marked lands whatever else is on the body and lasts until death. The T4 face says the arena boss is Marked at once (G2-5, A7b S6).

cap_chill_polarvortex.geometry: Iceburst shards, the icicle and its shards are projectiles blocked by the Carrier; the Windchill storm is a player-centred aura that passes (Ruling 1 names Windchill).
cap_chill_polarvortex.targeting: T1 shards burst radially from a slowed/frozen enemy's full-credit death; T3/T5 storm hits enemies within 130pt×DeviceScale of Spark (×2.1 at T5); the T4 icicle flies along the gun's aim.
cap_chill_polarvortex.hitClass: T1 3/5/7 shards at 15% (fragment, generation-capped), T2 Brittle Cold +40% direct-hit amplifier, T3 30% storm slow + 1 Chill/s, T4 every 3rd primary pellet → a 200% primary-eligible icicle that rolls the shot's crit and counts once toward Calculated Strike (A7b S9, CL-117), shattering into 3×30% shards that never crit, T5 5 Chill → 3s freeze → Frostbite +100% taken.
cap_chill_polarvortex.bossClass: Mini-bosses get an 85% slow for 1.5s instead of a freeze and +50% Frostbite (debuffScale); arena bosses are never slowed, frozen or Brittle-Cold-amplified, and the icicle only shatters on enemies.
cap_chill_polarvortex.tell: Frost bursts 0x99E6FF/0xCCF2FF, a swirling storm circle with gale wisps, frost-styled shots, and a santa hat + beard on Spark at T5 (v1.9 procedural FX).
cap_chill_polarvortex.sensitivities: T4 silences the pellet cards (CL-93 blockedBy, A7a) and Brittle Cold multiplies into the one unbiased direct-hit rounding, so it moves 1-damage hits too (CL-94, A7b S7); Frostbite is its own vulnerability channel (CL-107, A7b S6): the strongest active of Frostbite, Marked, Called and Fracture applies, never stacked, and Called ending no longer wipes a Frostbite window. A7b S9 (CL-110/117): the icicle rolls crit like the primary shot it replaces and counts once toward Calculated Strike (the absorbed pellets never count); its own shards never crit, while Iceburst's keep their roll. CL-93 is SYMMETRIC (Command Center correction, Sep 25): owning any pellet card (Warp Shot, Gravity Well, Mirror Edge, Fracture Shot, Riftline) closes T4 — T1–T3 stay open — and a Polar Vortex stalled at T3 neither gets its guarantee nor locks other capstones out (Brandon, Sep 25).

cap_fire_everglow.geometry: The pulse is a player-centred radius and the eruption is arena-wide; neither is occlusion-tested, so both pass the Carrier (Ruling 1 names Everglow).
cap_fire_everglow.targeting: Pulse every 2s hits every enemy within 70pt×DeviceScale of Spark (×2 at T2); the T5 eruption every 20s hits every enemy plus the arena boss after a 0.8s telegraph.
cap_fire_everglow.hitClass: Capstone AoE on the %ATK scale × Fire bucket: pulse 50% ATK (×2 at T4, +up to 100% from hits taken at T3), eruption 500% ATK; T4 hits taken also add up to +50% to the damage multiplier.
cap_fire_everglow.bossClass: BossClass.damageScale 50% (rounded) on mini-bosses and on the eruption's boss hit; the pulse never reaches the arena boss (CL-121 C2: kept so in v2.1; boss pulse tuning banked).
cap_fire_everglow.killSource: burst (reward-only) for both pulse and eruption kills; boss via onLethalHit.
cap_fire_everglow.tell: Orange 0xFF6633 ring per pulse; eruption = swelling orange core telegraph, arena blast, shake and a 🔥 ERUPTION HUD countdown (v1.9 procedural FX).
cap_fire_everglow.sensitivities: Pulse/eruption kills are reward-only (no Siphon, Frenzy, Ember Burst, Iceburst, kill count or arena gates); pulse-vs-boss is ruled CL-121 C2 (runtime unchanged); since A7b S11 the detail says 'The pulse skips bosses' (Brandon's pick at the copy gate; 652pt unchanged).

cap_guard_ironmaiden.geometry: Thorns and Retaliate are contact effects; the T4 burst is a player-centred aura (passes); the T5 target needs line of sight from Spark, then the strike cannot miss and its tracer may cross the Carrier (Geo Ruling 5).
cap_guard_ironmaiden.targeting: T1-T3 the toucher of a damaging contact; T4 every EnemyNode within 130pt x DeviceScale; T5 every 20s the shared priority target (arena boss, then nearest mini-boss, then nearest normal, visible from Spark).
cap_guard_ironmaiden.hitClass: Retaliation on damaging contacts (thorns flat 5 / 17, Retaliate 150% of the raw contact on a 1s global cooldown), T4 a 200% DEF radius burst at 4 kinetic stacks (built by contact and enemy-projectile hits), T5 a direct strike of stored kinetic + thorns; T1/T2 also convert base DEF into the damage multiplier.
cap_guard_ironmaiden.bossClass: Capstone lever applied once: thorns, Retaliate, T4 and T5 take BossClass.damageScale (50%) against mini-bosses and arena bosses; the T4 burst never reaches the arena boss.
cap_guard_ironmaiden.tell: Kinetic stack gauge; cyan-blue (0x1FB6FF) T4 ring and a T5 orb tracer with a white rim; no bespoke A5 art.
cap_guard_ironmaiden.sensitivities: Iron Skin's DEF->damage reads base DEF only (not Fortify or Deeproot) and is flagged for balance.

cap_shock_skybeam.geometry: The T1–T4 lasso is a supernatural tether that crosses the Carrier (Ruling 5) and the T5 strike descends from above (Ruling 6); neither is occlusion-tested.
cap_shock_skybeam.targeting: The lasso holds the nearest enemy or boss within 0.35×arena radius (0.70 at T2, retention ×1.4); the T5 strike every 5s hits the lassoed prey, else the nearest enemy or boss by distance with no range limit.
cap_shock_skybeam.hitClass: Capstone %ATK damage: lasso tick 15%/30% ATK per second, T3 steers auto-aim to the prey, T4 Called +35% taken after 2s attached, T5 300% ATK bolt after a 1s windup plus 150% ATK to every other enemy within 80pt×DeviceScale.
cap_shock_skybeam.bossClass: All Skybeam damage is at BossClass.damageScale 50% (rounded) on mini-bosses and bosses; Called is +17.5% on boss-class (debuffScale).
cap_shock_skybeam.tell: Cyan 0x66DDFF tether; the strike is a contracting 0x88EEFF warning ring, descending charge, white multi-bolt, double shockwave, screen flash and thunderclap (v1.9 procedural FX).
cap_shock_skybeam.sensitivities: T3 Homing hands auto-aim the lassoed prey only with the gun's line of sight, else it falls through (A7b S13, CL-109); on gun and sweep hits Called folds into the one direct-hit rounding (CL-114, A7b S8; other sources still round it in-node); lasso and strike ignore hittability, but T3 Homing never hands auto-aim an intangible prey (A7b S12, CL-126). Called is its own vulnerability channel (CL-107, A7b S6): it never downgrades a stronger mark (a Frostbitten prey stays at +100%), and letting go of the lasso clears only Called. A7b: CL-109 ruled — Carrier geometry is respected unless the mechanic has an explicit terrain exemption; invalid persistent placements and pathing get fixed.

cap_void_erasure.geometry: T3 rift and T4 echo ORIGINS are sampled valid (PlacementSampler); the T3 beam crosses the Carrier as reality-piercing Void (Geo Ruling 3); Displacement resolves out of solids; T4 echo shots are ordinary projectiles; T5 is positionless.
cap_void_erasure.targeting: T1 meter fills on every main-chain projectile hit (enemy or boss) and every Red Smile contact (4 hits, 0.15s rate limit); when full and off cooldown one random table effect fires at the nearest non-dying normal enemy (no line-of-sight or hittability filter); with no enemy alive it falls back to the arena boss if that boss can be hit (else the charge holds), rolling only Rift Burst, Damage Echo or Fracture (A7b S11, CL-119 A1).
cap_void_erasure.hitClass: T1 table (Implosion 55pt pull, path-tested since A7b S14, Rift Burst 100% ATK r110, Phase Lock 1s stun, Damage Echo 60% ATK after 0.35s, Displacement 85pt, Fracture +40% taken 3s, Backwash 6 shards at 30%); T2 every shot ignores Braceguard and the trigger cooldown drops 2.0 -> 1.2s; T3 every 3rd trigger a 300% ATK beam 46pt wide; T4 each pellet re-fires 1.5s later at 50%; T5 erases the arena at 75s and the player at 105s (x arena scale by arena number: 0.5 for Arenas 1–10, 0.65 for 11–20, 0.8 for 21–30, full from 31).
cap_void_erasure.bossClass: Capstone lever on Rift Burst, Damage Echo, Rift Cannon and the mini-boss Phase Lock slow and Fracture; the T1 trigger targets the arena boss only as the lone-boss fallback (Rift Burst 50% ATK, Damage Echo 30% ATK, Fracture +20% taken for 3s on its own game-time window; CL-119 A1), the T3 beam hits it at 50%, and T5 kills it outright (Boss Mode too).
cap_void_erasure.killSource: burst (Rift Burst), capstone (Damage Echo, Rift Cannon), fragment (Backwash, T4 echoes); T5's erase removes enemies uncredited.
cap_void_erasure.tell: Unstable HUD gauge in purple 0x9B59B6 (UI exception) with indigo in-world rings, pops, beam and T2 bolts; T5 purple 'VOID COLLAPSE' countdown and screen tints (UI exception).
cap_void_erasure.sensitivities: A7b S11 (CL-119 A1): a full meter no longer sits idle in boss-only fights, and boss lurches advance T3's Rift Cannon too; its T1 rung says so, '… (a lone boss: 50%)' (Brandon's pick at the S11 copy gate; modal held at 665pt); T2 copy overclaims and T5 copy says 75s/105s while arenas 1-10 run 37.5s/52.5s (CL-101); the Boss Mode 'catastrophic damage' T5 branch was never built (closeout); Fracture is CL-107's fourth vulnerability channel (CL-116, A7b S6): it never overwrites a stronger mark, and its expiry clears only itself.

chill_1.geometry: Rides projectile hits, so delivery is blocked by the Carrier's swept segment test; the status itself has no geometry.
chill_1.targeting: Any landed player projectile with appliesFrostTouch (default true; Iceburst shards and icicle fragments only from T3); never Glass Blood fragments, Void secondaries or Red Smile sweeps.
chill_1.hitClass: On-hit slow 25%/50% for 2s (× Chill ×3 potency, cap 80%); T3 turns the shard flag on.
chill_1.bossClass: Mini-bosses take the full slow (no debuffScale); arena bosses are never slowed (the boss hit path has no slow).
chill_1.tell: Slowed enemy body turns navy 0x112233 with blue 0x4488FF eyes (legacy tint).
chill_1.sensitivities: T3 is a dead rung without Polar Vortex — CL-92 gates it on `.polarVortex` (A7a eligibility); the same hit's slow already counts toward Shatter and Iceburst.

chill_2.hitClass: Stat only: +30% projectile speed, read by every projectile built from effectiveProjectileSpeed (shards and Glass Blood fragments included).
chill_2.sensitivities: Value from the Sep 15 spec table (range bonus dropped in A2); no numbered ruling.

chill_3.hitClass: Direct-hit amplifier: +25% on gun and Red Smile hits against an enemy that is slowed, or any enemy while a global slow is active; it multiplies with Brittle Cold and Open Wounds as fractions and the hit rounds ONCE, unbiased (CL-94, A7b S7).
chill_3.bossClass: Enemy paths only — the gun and sweep boss paths skip it, so arena bosses never take it.
chill_3.sensitivities: A 1-damage hit now deals 2 a quarter of the time (a mean of 1.25), where it used to add nothing below 4 damage (CL-94, A7b S7); the copy says so (G2-1).

chill_4.geometry: Patches drop at Spark's own (always valid) position, so none originate inside the Carrier; visuals may overlap it but no enemy can stand there; the T5 rink is arena-wide.
chill_4.targeting: Every enemy standing on a live patch (22pt×DeviceScale, +30% at T3), refreshed 0.5s; T5 slows every enemy through the global slow.
chill_4.hitClass: Zone slow 8% (× Chill ×3 potency) from patches dropped every 0.15s while the stick moves; patch life 2/3.5/5s, T4 permanent for the arena, T5 Ice Rink −50% enemies / +25% Spark move.
chill_4.bossClass: Mini-bosses slowed in full; arena bosses never (the trail loops enemies and bosses don't read globalEnemySlow).
chill_4.tell: Pale frost patches 0x88CCFF/0xAADDFF off one shared texture; T5 glazes the whole floor 0xCCF2FF — placeholder, A9 replaces.
chill_4.sensitivities: T4 painting is a device perf watch (merge-bounded); Ice Rink lights Permafrost arena-wide (Q-C5); the +1 Card bonus could re-offer T5 without Whiteout until CL-89's shared predicate (A7a). A7b: CL-108 ruled — arena bosses stay immune to the Ice Rink / Absolute Zero slow (the runtime already was); since S10 the copy says so (G2-4 detail 'non-boss enemies', G2-3 line 'Non-boss foes slow').

fire_1.geometry: Rides projectile hits, so delivery is blocked by the Carrier's swept segment test; the status itself has no geometry.
fire_1.targeting: Any player projectile that lands (primary pellets, PV icicle, and also echoes, splits and shards — no allowModifiers gate); never Glass Blood fragments, returned shots, Shadow Edge or Red Smile sweeps.
fire_1.hitClass: On-hit Burn rider (+0.5 DPS per stack, 2s, × Fire bucket at ignition) applied as a `.kindleHit`, so it can add a Crucible stack; ticks pay out as Burn-channel DoT hits.
fire_1.bossClass: Arena bosses and mini-bosses ignite and take Burn at BossClass.dotScale 50%, fraction-first before rounding; ticks ignore the Boss Mode DEF dial (CL-18).
fire_1.killSource: statusTick (a boss kill credits via the onLethalHit chokepoint with a burn-channel context).
fire_1.tell: Enemy rim glows orange 0xFF6633 while burning; bosses show ember pips in the status row beside the HP bar — A1/A4a placeholders, A9 replaces.
fire_1.sensitivities: Shards/echoes/splits also count as Kindle hits (unlike Frost Touch's T3 shard gate); sweeps never ignite (CL-39 'Projectiles…'); the post-Burn rim reset hard-codes red on themed enemies (A4a log).

fire_2.hitClass: Stat only: fireDamageBonus (+25/50/100% totals) multiplies Fire-owned damage — Kindle Burn and its spread, Ember Burst, Everglow pulse and eruption, Inferno Crown.
fire_2.bossClass: Inherits each Fire effect's own boss treatment; no boss-specific term.
fire_2.sensitivities: Never touches shot damage, Relay Burn arcs or the Shock ×5 tesla field; Ember Burst stays 1 at base even at +100% (Int(0.5) floors to the minimum 1).

fire_3.geometry: Non-travel radius burst at the death point with no occlusion test, so it passes the Carrier (Ruling 1 radius class).
fire_3.targeting: Every enemy (mini-bosses included) within a fixed 60pt of a full-credit kill (not DeviceScale-scaled); never the arena boss.
fire_3.hitClass: On-kill secondary burst for max(1, Int(damageMultiplier × 25% × Fire bucket)) — base multiplier only, so Overcharge doesn't count; no crit or riders.
fire_3.bossClass: Mini-bosses take it unscaled; the arena boss is never hit, but a boss death fires one burst at the death position (CL-29).
fire_3.killSource: burst (reward-only: XP orb, no on-kill cascade).
fire_3.tell: Orange 0xFF6633 expanding blast disc (legacy procedural FX).
fire_3.sensitivities: 1 damage at base on the integer scale (A1 open item 3, accepted); inert in add-less boss fights (CL-95).

fire_4.geometry: n/a — a stacking rule on the Burn status.
fire_4.targeting: Per enemy and per arena boss; only Kindle-hit applications add stacks — Spreading Flame and the tesla field reignite but never add.
fire_4.hitClass: Burn stacks to 5, at most +1 per 3s per target, each stack at full Burn DPS; when Burn ends damage stops and stacks fade 1 per 2s, and a reignite preserves the survivors (CL-16).
fire_4.bossClass: Stacks build on bosses and mini-bosses with count and durations unscaled; damage at dotScale 50%.
fire_4.tell: Rim glow thickens per live stack and ember pips appear from 2 stacks (gold 0xFFB84D live, dim 0x8A4A2A dormant); boss status row mirrors it — placeholder, A9 replaces.
fire_4.sensitivities: Stacked Burn on mini-bosses is the biggest Fire DPS lever (A1 open item 6, revisit at Arena 11+); tesla-held stacks stay dim and never extend Kindle's Burn (A4a fix).

guard_1.geometry: n/a; the rescue aftermath's 40pt shove of enemies within 50pt goes through the one path-tested shove (A7b S14, CL-124a).
guard_1.targeting: None: fires on the first lethal hit (HP reaches 0) through the shared damage pipeline or Unstable Core self-damage.
guard_1.hitClass: Lethal rescue #1: HP set to 1 plus a 1s damage-cooldown grace; a barrier-only hit can never reach it.
guard_1.bossClass: Source-agnostic (boss, mini-boss, hazard or self-damage); Erasure T5's forced erase bypasses it.
guard_1.tell: Spark alpha-blink flash plus screen shake; placeholder until A9.
guard_1.sensitivities: Two cheat-deaths with Unbroken Core are intended (Q-G1); Brace always spends first, never both on one lethal event.

guard_2.geometry: Knockback row: T1/T2 shoves are path-tested and stop at the last free point; T3 launches stop at the arena wall and at the Carrier (exact segment test every step, landing step included).
guard_2.targeting: Every projectile hit on an EnemyNode through the main hit chain (pellets, icicle, echoes, fragments, seeds, flower/turret shots), directed away from Spark; never Glass Blood fragments, returned shots, Shadow Edge or Red Smile sweeps.
guard_2.hitClass: Projectile on-hit rider (not primary-only): T1 20pt / T2 60pt shove, T3 400pt launch over 0.35s whose collisions are their own direct hit of max(1, 25% effective ATK), each pin once per launch, 3 pins max.
guard_2.bossClass: Arena bosses and snowmen are immune; mini-bosses take a fixed 20pt at every tier and are never launched or used as pins; Void-trapped bodies are not displaced.
guard_2.killSource: impact (T3 collisions); the carrying projectile keeps its own source.
guard_2.tell: T3 only: steel (0xB8B2A6) trail motes and a steel impact ring per pin; T1/T2 shoves have no dedicated tell; placeholder until A9.
guard_2.sensitivities: Launches mostly reach the arena wall (400pt is about the arena radius); against 1-HP early mobs the shot usually kills before launching, so bowling matters from tougher waves on.

guard_3.geometry: The bounce shove is path-tested and stops at the last free point before the Carrier.
guard_3.targeting: Every real touch-begin by a hittable, non-snowman EnemyNode, before the i-frame and damage-cooldown guards.
guard_3.hitClass: Stat (collision radius x0.70) plus a 40pt contact bounce that never creates damage; Harden and Aegis share one bounce and the largest owned distance wins.
guard_3.bossClass: Arena bosses are never moved; mini-bosses bounce like normals; snowmen are harmless to touch and never reach the bounce.
guard_3.tell: The shrink has no visual; each bounce draws a small steel contact ring (astral blue once Aegis is T2+); placeholder until A9.
guard_3.sensitivities: The shrunk body is the one body for contact, enemy shots, geometry and every pickup (health orbs too); bounced enemies return for fresh contacts (A5 watch 4); boss hazards reach the shrunk body too — Quench Warden lanes, the Dynamo Choir litany, the Faceted Lie's plates and Pane burst, and the Quench Field's wall clamp (A7b S15, CL-127d); centre-point hazards (the Titan and Anvilborn slams, the Star, Standardfall) stay centre-point.

guard_4.targeting: Self: stillness is stick input only, so forced moves don't reset it and pushing into a wall does.
guard_4.hitClass: Stat only: +1 temporary DEF per 0.5s without stick input, cap +30, any input resets it, no combat needed, clock starts at ownership.
guard_4.bossClass: n/a (flat DEF against every source, floor 1 per hit).
guard_4.tell: A steel blip per point plus the HUD DEF row's '+N'; placeholder until A9.
guard_4.sensitivities: Feeds current DEF, so it pumps Aegis spikes, Iron Bloom and the Unbroken snapshot (A5 watch 7); Fortify 30 + Grounded 30 floors ordinary melee to 1 until about 3:30 (A5 watch 3); stat-pick rebalance deferred to closeout.

neutral_1.hitClass: Stat only: +12% movement speed (additive to the move-speed multiplier).
neutral_1.tell: None beyond the HUD move-speed row.
neutral_1.sensitivities: Neutral ships unchanged in v2.1; its redesign is deferred to v2.2+.

neutral_2.targeting: XP orbs only; health orbs stay non-magnetized.
neutral_2.sensitivities: Stacks with Magnetic Core and Devour's 2x.

neutral_3.hitClass: Stat only: firing interval x0.90, a real +11.1% firing rate.
neutral_3.tell: None beyond the HUD ATK SPD row.
neutral_3.sensitivities: CL-101 compatibility copy: '+10% attack speed' -> '+11%' (the firing-rate convention).

neutral_4.targeting: Every projectile built from effective range, including the auto-aim acquisition range, Shadow Edge and returned shots.
neutral_4.sensitivities: The only range source besides Riftline's +25% since Phase lost its range in A6.

neutral_6.targeting: Adds pellets to each auto-aim volley: 2 pellets fire as parallel columns, 3+ fan into a static cone.
neutral_6.hitClass: Each extra pellet is a full primary shot (every modifier, echo, Fracture, Warp and Gravity Well roll), while the volley still counts once for the Void volley counter.
neutral_6.sensitivities: Storm Engine's spread volley is the normal count + 2 (CL-98), so every Scatter tier adds a pellet to it too; CL-101 copy: T1 '(wider spread)' -> two parallel shots; Polar Vortex T4 absorbs the pellets.

shock_1.hitClass: Stat only: +15/30/50% real fire rate (totals) inside the shared effectiveFireInterval.
shock_1.sensitivities: Also speeds Red Smile swings, which have no interval floor (CL-42).

shock_2.geometry: Enemy-to-enemy hops are not occlusion-tested, so chains cross the Carrier; no geometry ruling names chain hops.
shock_2.targeting: From the struck enemy, repeatedly the nearest unvisited enemy within 80pt×DeviceScale of the last victim — distinct targets, skipping anything that can't be hit, dying or intangible (A7b S12, CL-127a).
shock_2.hitClass: Chain hop: flat compounded damage off the triggering hit (T1 50%, T2 75%, T3 85% per jump, T4 100%, floor 1) with only an Overload roll; fires from any projectile hit on an enemy (not Glass Blood fragments or Void secondaries), Electro Pulse, and once per Red Smile swing.
shock_2.bossClass: Boss hits never start a chain and chains never jump to the arena boss; mini-bosses take hops unscaled.
shock_2.tell: Jagged blue 0x44BBFF bolt that thickens and glows harder per tier, plus a ring pulse on each victim.
shock_2.sensitivities: Never hops onto a phased PaneStalker (A4c Q6, fixed in A7b S12); lethal hits still chain from the victim's position (A3 ruling 0); copy should say boss hits never chain (CL-101). A7b S13 (CL-109 / CL-123a): a hop needs a clear line from the last victim — the nearest enemy it can see, else the chain ends.

shock_3.hitClass: Stat only: +10% move speed, +20% projectile speed, +10% real fire rate.
shock_3.tell: HUD MV SPD / ATK SPD rows.
shock_3.sensitivities: Value from the Sep 15 spec table; the fire-rate part also speeds Red Smile swings.

shock_4.geometry: n/a — a status on the struck enemy, delivered by its carriers.
shock_4.targeting: Each struck enemy on any landed projectile, Red Smile sweep hit, Chain Lightning hop or Electro Pulse survivor; never coils, Relay arcs or DoTs.
shock_4.hitClass: 20% stun for 1s, or 35%/2s while Chain Lightning is T4 (linked, no extra pick), with 3s Overload-only immunity after a stun ends.
shock_4.bossClass: Mini-bosses get fixed 0.25s / 0.5s linked stuns applied once; arena bosses are immune (the boss hit path never rolls).
shock_4.tell: Three yellow ✦ 0xFFE066 dazed stars orbiting the head — placeholder, A9 replaces.
shock_4.sensitivities: An Overload stun that lands on a snowman runs its full duration after the form ends or melts (independent holds, A7b S5); copy 'Elites and mini-bosses' should read 'Mini-bosses' (CL-101).

v13_chain_reaction.geometry: Point burst at the corpse with no occlusion test (not reviewed under the section 3 matrix).
v13_chain_reaction.targeting: On every full-credit kill (and an arena boss's death, once), every EnemyNode within 35pt of the death point.
v13_chain_reaction.hitClass: On-kill radius burst of a bare 1 flat damage (no riders, not ATK-scaled).
v13_chain_reaction.bossClass: Never damages the arena boss; mini-bosses take the flat 1.
v13_chain_reaction.killSource: None at the hit: its kills fall to the frame-top prune (sweep, reward-only), so it can't chain.
v13_chain_reaction.tell: An orange-yellow (0xFFCC44 / 0xFF8800) ring at the death point.
v13_chain_reaction.sensitivities: Inert in boss-only fights (CL-95 list); reward-only kills are a closeout audit item. A7b (CL-123c): a point burst, exempt under Geo Ruling 1 (non-travel radius effects pass; at 35pt it can't reach across the Carrier anyway).

v13_execution.hitClass: Direct-hit amplifier: ×2 below 30% HP on gun and Red Smile hits; where Exsanguinate overlaps it is one ×2, never ×4.
v13_execution.bossClass: Applies to arena bosses and mini-bosses too.
v13_execution.sensitivities: Never applies to DoTs, chains, coils or capstone damage; partly redundant with Exsanguinate (its own value is the 25–30% band).

v13_glass_engine.hitClass: Stat only: +100% real fire rate (interval ÷2 inside the shared effectiveFireInterval) and a one-time −50% max HP at pick (Int-truncated).
v13_glass_engine.tell: HUD ATK SPD and HP bar change; no other tell.
v13_glass_engine.sensitivities: Also speeds Red Smile swings; max-HP gains taken later are not halved (order-dependent); Blood Barrier clamps to the lowered cap.

v13_magnetic_core.targeting: XP orbs; the speed burst on each XP orb collected.
v13_magnetic_core.hitClass: Stat only: +50% XP-orb magnet radius and +30% move speed for 1.5s on each XP orb collected.
v13_magnetic_core.sensitivities: With Chain Reaction it fires the 'Clear Engine' build hint.

v13_overcharge.hitClass: Stat only: +5% damage multiplier per second unhit, cap +50%, reset by any resolved hit including barrier-only ones (CL-5).
v13_overcharge.tell: None; the HUD ATK row deliberately excludes it (displayDamageMultiplier).
v13_overcharge.sensitivities: Split out of a shot's integer base at fire time and the sweep's base (CL-114a, A7b S8): it rides the direct-hit block as a factor, so a shot whose base is at least 1 gains its +5…+50% by chance (a scaled shot below 1 — an echo, a fragment — gains nothing) and no BASE ever pays below its old floor (Iron Skin / Everglow integer crossings included). The integer steps after the base (a non-integer crit multiplier such as Deadeye's ×2.1 / ×3.1, Lucky Break, Forge offense, Killing Stroke) act on the Overcharge-free base, so at an integer crossing those builds can land up to about 1 below today (A7b independent review M1; Brandon, Oct 1: ships as built, a hit-level fix is banked for v2.1.x/v2.2); acorns, seed fragments, Glass Blood and the Void secondaries keep it in their base as before. It still raises %ATK effects (Bleed ticks, Skybeam, bat, Everglow).

v13_phase_skin.targeting: Self: the first hit past the i-frame and cooldown guards (and past the Unbroken shield and Silver Skin) from a contact, an enemy projectile or a boss hazard.
v13_phase_skin.hitClass: The triggering hit is ignored and grants 1s invulnerability, 3.5s cooldown measured from the trigger; Unstable Core self-damage never triggers it.
v13_phase_skin.bossClass: Source-agnostic (boss contact and boss hazards included).
v13_phase_skin.tell: Spark blinks five times with a light shake; placeholder until A9.
v13_phase_skin.sensitivities: CL-101 copy pass: the face should say the triggering hit is ignored too; Phase Skin + Hoarfrost fires the 'Survivor Loop' build hint.

v13_unstable_core.targeting: Every 4s, every EnemyNode within 60pt of Spark (no hittability filter).
v13_unstable_core.hitClass: A bare 2-damage burst (no riders, not ATK-scaled) plus self-damage of max(1, 10 - current flat DEF) outside the pipeline (no barrier, no percentage DR, lands through i-frames), rescued Brace then Unbroken; only Unbroken's window blocks it, and it applies only when the burst struck a live enemy (A7b S11, CL-120 B1′).
v13_unstable_core.bossClass: Never hits the arena boss; mini-bosses take the flat 2; with nothing in range the burst still fires but can't hurt you (CL-120 B1′), so an add-less boss fight costs nothing.
v13_unstable_core.killSource: None at the hit: its kills fall to the frame-top prune (sweep, reward-only).
v13_unstable_core.tell: Expanding indigo (0x6688FF / 0x4466DD) ring from Spark plus a small shake (recoloured from purple in A6).
v13_unstable_core.sensitivities: A7b S11 (CL-120 B1′): empty bursts no longer cost HP, so they no longer feed Everglow T3/T4's hit-taken growth either (a device-pass feel item); uncredited kills are a closeout item; Guard DEF shrinks the self-cost (CL-101 copy); with 2+ Void cards it fires the 'Chaos Build' hint.

v16_aegis_pulse.geometry: The bounce shove is path-tested at the Carrier; the spike needs no test because the toucher is adjacent.
v16_aegis_pulse.targeting: DR applies to every pipeline hit; from T2 the bounce and spike fire on every touch-begin by a hittable enemy or boss, even during Unbroken invulnerability.
v16_aegis_pulse.hitClass: Percentage DR in the pipeline's aegis slot (25 / 25 / 35%) inside the shared 90% ceiling; the T2/T3 spike is ordinary direct damage of max(1, 50% / 75% current DEF) with no bypass.
v16_aegis_pulse.bossClass: The arena boss takes the spike through plain takeDamage (DEF dial applies) but is never moved; mini-bosses are bounced and spiked at full.
v16_aegis_pulse.tell: Astral-blue (0xA8C8FF) heater shield with a white rim on Spark's LEFT, x1.3 at T3, hidden under the kaiju, blue contact ring on bounce, never purple; placeholder until A9.
v16_aegis_pulse.sensitivities: Ironhide + Aegis reach the 90% ceiling in a crowd (A5 watch 2); a spike-killed toucher still lands its hit (A5-Q2); Unstable Core self-damage skips the DR.

v16_cauterize.hitClass: Stat only: +5 HP after each continuous 3s below 25% max HP; leaving the threshold resets the timer.
v16_cauterize.sensitivities: Not combat-gated; a tick may carry HP above 25%.

v16_hoarfrost.hitClass: Stat only: +5 HP every 7s, always on.
v16_hoarfrost.sensitivities: Not combat-gated; value from the Sep 15 spec table (no numbered ruling); pairs with Phase Skin as the Survivor Loop (A2 item 4).

v16_iron_bloom.geometry: Ruled exception to the aura pass: each target needs a clear exact segment from Spark, so the Carrier blocks the spikes (CL-60).
v16_iron_bloom.targeting: Every 4s on game time (remainder carried): every hittable enemy whose surface is within 70pt x DeviceScale of Spark, plus the arena boss.
v16_iron_bloom.hitClass: Direct pulse damage of max(1, 50% current DEF) with no crit or on-hit riders; 'piercing' means it skips the Boss Mode flat DEF dial only.
v16_iron_bloom.bossClass: Mini-bosses and the arena boss take it at full (not a capstone, no BossClass scaling); the boss hit uses ignoresChallengeDEF.
v16_iron_bloom.tell: Steel ring plus eight steel spikes thrown out from Spark; placeholder until A9.
v16_iron_bloom.sensitivities: DEF-fed offense: Fortify, Deeproot and Grounded Core raise it (A5 watch 7).

v16_null_bloom.geometry: Opens at the death position; the centre is resolved out of solids and clamped inside the wall.
v16_null_bloom.targeting: 30% of full-credit kills (and an arena boss's death, once, at its position).
v16_null_bloom.hitClass: No damage on its own: a 36pt x DeviceScale (0.6 x Blackhole), 0.8s pull hole that counts as a black hole for the synergies (provides .voidWell).
v16_null_bloom.bossClass: Mini-bosses are pulled at 50%; arena bosses are never pulled.
v16_null_bloom.killSource: n/a (ground via Dead Circuit or Singularity)
v16_null_bloom.tell: Indigo ring with a lighter fill than the other holes and no dark core; placeholder until A9.
v16_null_bloom.sensitivities: Counts toward the 4-live-hole cap and can evict an older hole mid-pass (review F2 re-checks liveness).

v16_open_vein.geometry: Non-travel radius burst at the death point, so it passes the Carrier (Ruling 1 radius class).
v16_open_vein.targeting: Every enemy within a fixed 40pt (not DeviceScale) of a full-credit kill whose victim was bleeding before the killing damage.
v16_open_vein.hitClass: On-kill secondary burst for a flat 2 damage, no riders.
v16_open_vein.bossClass: Never damages the arena boss; a bleeding boss's death fires one burst at its position (CL-29); mini-bosses unscaled.
v16_open_vein.tell: Red 0xCC2233 ring pulse at the death point.
v16_open_vein.sensitivities: Flat 2 is twice base shot damage; its kills can't cascade into further bursts.

v16_static_crown.geometry: An expanding ring evaluated by distance only, so it passes the Carrier (Ruling 1 radius class).
v16_static_crown.targeting: On each level-up, a ring centred where Spark levelled grows to 260pt×DeviceScale over 4s, striking each enemy it reaches once.
v16_static_crown.hitClass: Secondary burst for 150% shot damage (min 1), no crit or riders.
v16_static_crown.bossClass: Enemies only — never the arena boss; mini-bosses unscaled.
v16_static_crown.tell: Bright yellow 0xFFE066 glowing ring expanding and fading.
v16_static_crown.sensitivities: Kills are reward-only (no Siphon, Frenzy or kill count).

v16_whiteout.geometry: n/a — a state on the struck enemy, delivered by projectile/sweep carriers the Carrier blocks.
v16_whiteout.targeting: Survivors of any landed player projectile (primary, shards, echoes, icicle) or Red Smile sweep, each enemy at most once per 10s; never chains, coils, DoTs or Glass Blood fragments.
v16_whiteout.hitClass: 12% on-hit transform into a harmless snowman (a stun in costume) for 3s/6s; at T3 any damage melts it — normals die, mini-bosses take the hit plus 20% max HP.
v16_whiteout.bossClass: Mini-bosses transform for half as long (debuffScale); arena bosses are structurally immune (not EnemyNodes).
v16_whiteout.killSource: Whatever damage melted it (e.g. primary, statusTick, melee).
v16_whiteout.tell: Two snowballs, coal eyes and a carrot; the melt is a blue smiling puddle — placeholder, A9 replaces.
v16_whiteout.sensitivities: The form is its own hold: ending or melting it never cuts an overlapping timed stun (Overload, a panda's prune, Phase Lock), which runs its remaining time (A7b S5); snowmen can't be trapped or feared and don't count for Ironhide. A7b reconcile (Brandon, Sep 25): mini-boss snowmen last half as long (the runtime already did); since S10 the detail says '(elites for half as long)' (G2-6). A melting snowman mini-boss that shatters takes the Shatter chunk plus the melt's 20%: 40% in one hit (CL-118).

v17_dead_circuit.geometry: In-hole damage has no occlusion test; the collapse burst is Carrier-blocked per target (exact segment from the hole centre).
v17_dead_circuit.targeting: Modifies every player black hole: damages hittable enemies inside; matter = a full-credit, non-collapse kill inside (fed once to every containing hole) or an absorbed hostile shot.
v17_dead_circuit.hitClass: Holes last x1.5, deal 1x current shot damage per second (fraction-first), grow +25% radius per matter, and at 3 matter collapse for max(1, 150% effective ATK) through ordinary defenses.
v17_dead_circuit.bossClass: In-hole damage never reaches the arena boss; the collapse hits the boss (DEF dial applies) and mini-bosses at full, no BossClass scaling.
v17_dead_circuit.killSource: ground (tick and collapse, full credit); collapse kills feed no hole.
v17_dead_circuit.tell: Holes visibly grow; the collapse is a white-and-indigo flash burst; placeholder until A9.
v17_dead_circuit.sensitivities: Rarely reaches a natural collapse in Gravity-Well-heavy builds as the cap churns (A6 watch 5; don't tune without Brandon); its tick also damages snowmen.

v17_grounded_core.targeting: Self: still (no stick input) AND in active combat (the shared CombatPresence flag, read this frame).
v17_grounded_core.hitClass: Stat only: +1 permanent base DEF per uninterrupted 7.5s, cap +30 per run; moving or leaving combat resets unfinished progress.
v17_grounded_core.bossClass: n/a (active combat counts any hittable enemy or boss).
v17_grounded_core.tell: Guard-green (0x88AA44) progress arc at Spark's feet, a '+1 DEF' pop, a faint full ring once capped, hidden under the kaiju; placeholder until A9.
v17_grounded_core.sensitivities: Turtling vs active play with Fortify (A5 watch 3); earned DEF survives death and revive, unfinished progress does not.

v17_overclock.hitClass: Stat only: +35% move speed for 3s after each level-up.

v17_relay_burn.geometry: Instant enemy-to-enemy arc with no occlusion test, so it crosses the Carrier; no geometry ruling names enemy-to-enemy arcs.
v17_relay_burn.targeting: Each burning enemy (Kindle or tesla-field Burn) rolls 0.9/s; target = nearest other enemy within a fixed 90pt (not DeviceScale), skipping dying or intangible bodies (A7b S12, CL-127a).
v17_relay_burn.hitClass: Secondary flat 4-damage Shock arc: no crit, amplifiers, Overload roll or Chain Lightning.
v17_relay_burn.bossClass: Enemies only — a burning boss never arcs and the boss is never a target; mini-bosses take the flat 4.
v17_relay_burn.tell: Thin blue 0x44BBFF arc line with a 0.15s fade (legacy FX).
v17_relay_burn.sensitivities: Flat 4 is ~4× base shot damage and never scales; copy lacks its numbers (CL-101 adds 4 dmg / 90pt); inert in add-less boss fights (CL-95); CL-89 stops the +1 Card bonus offering it with Shock dormant. A7b S13 (CL-123a): the arc needs a clear line from the burning source — the nearest enemy it can see, else none.

v18_bloodlust.hitClass: Stat only: +0.1% real fire rate per full-credit kill of an already-bleeding enemy, permanent for the run, capped at +30%.
v18_bloodlust.bossClass: A bleeding boss kill counts once (CL-29).
v18_bloodlust.tell: HUD ATK SPD row shows the live rate.
v18_bloodlust.sensitivities: Only visible because the FireClock carry keeps sub-frame time (CL-23); ~300 bleeding kills to cap.

v18_false_opening.geometry: Radius pulse with no occlusion test (aura pass); the mark drops at Spark's own, always-valid position.
v18_false_opening.targeting: A sharp stick turn (over 90 degrees vs a lagging heading, stick above 0.3) marks the pivot; 0.3s later it pulses every enemy within 72pt, 1.1s cooldown.
v18_false_opening.hitClass: One-shot area burst, not a lingering field: flat 12 damage plus a 30% slow for 1.2s, no riders, not ATK-scaled.
v18_false_opening.bossClass: Never hits the arena boss; mini-bosses take the full damage and slow.
v18_false_opening.tell: A faint indigo mark fading into a light-indigo (0x6688FF) ring pulse (recoloured from the Faceted Lie's danger purple in A6).
v18_false_opening.sensitivities: Inert in boss-only fights (CL-95 list); reward-only kills are a closeout audit item; CL-101 copy: add a detail with the 30% / 1.2s slow and the flat 12. A7b (CL-123c): a point burst, exempt under Geo Ruling 1 (non-travel radius effects pass).

v18_fracture_shot.geometry: Ordinary direct projectiles, blocked by the Carrier.
v18_fracture_shot.targeting: Each primary pellet also fires 2 fragments angled 0.22 rad either side of its line.
v18_fracture_shot.hitClass: Secondary projectile (no modifiers): 50% of the pellet's damage with standard projectile riders, no primary-only riders, never re-splits.
v18_fracture_shot.sensitivities: Silenced by Polar Vortex T4, and CL-93 (A7a) stops offering it once T4 is owned; fragments pick up Riftline pierce and falloff and Repulse. CL-93 symmetric: owning this card closes Polar Vortex T4 (T1–T3 unaffected); owning Polar Vortex T4 stops it being offered.

v18_glass_blood.geometry: Fragments are projectiles, so the Carrier blocks them.
v18_glass_blood.targeting: 3 fragments fan radially from an enemy (or boss) killed by a Bleed tick at generation 0 or 1, with 150pt×DeviceScale range at 0.9× projectile speed.
v18_glass_blood.hitClass: Fragment hit: 30% shot damage (min 1) with no crit, pierce or riders, guaranteed Bleed on a survivor at parent generation + 1, and Braceguard shields still halve it.
v18_glass_blood.bossClass: Fragments hit and bleed the arena boss (Boss Mode DEF dial applies); a boss killed by a Bleed tick bursts once at its death position (CL-29).
v18_glass_blood.tell: Red 0xE0203A blood-glass shard projectiles with a 0xFF8A99 edge and a red burst ring.
v18_glass_blood.sensitivities: Each lineage stops after two hops but fresh primary wounds re-root outbreaks; dense-swarm frame-rate watch (A4b gate 6).

v18_mirror_edge.geometry: The echo is an ordinary direct projectile, blocked by the Carrier.
v18_mirror_edge.targeting: Each primary pellet has a 35% chance to re-fire once, 0.15s later, on the same heading from Spark's then-current position.
v18_mirror_edge.hitClass: Secondary projectile (no modifiers): 50% of the pellet's damage with the standard projectile riders but no primary-only ones (no Anomaly, fear, Warp, Gravity Well or counter), and it never echoes again.
v18_mirror_edge.tell: Looks like a normal shot; no dedicated tell.
v18_mirror_edge.sensitivities: Silenced by Polar Vortex T4, and CL-93 (A7a) stops offering it once T4 is owned; CL-101 copy: state the 35% chance and 50% damage. CL-93 symmetric: owning this card closes Polar Vortex T4 (T1–T3 unaffected); owning Polar Vortex T4 stops it being offered.

v18_red_smile.geometry: Each target needs a clear exact segment from Spark (segmentBlockedExact), so the Carrier blocks the sweep regardless of Void affinity (CL-38).
v18_red_smile.targeting: Every hittable enemy and the arena boss whose body overlaps a 110° × 80pt×DeviceScale sector facing Spark's last move direction, nearest first; intangible targets are skipped.
v18_red_smile.hitClass: Primary hit per target (not a shot or projectile) at 2× current shot damage with crit rolled per target, carrying 'Hits…' riders and a guaranteed Bleed, one Chain Lightning per swing, and no Kindle, Frost Touch, Repulse or shot counters.
v18_red_smile.bossClass: Same damage basis on bosses and mini-bosses with no BossClass scaling; the Boss Mode DEF dial applies and Void bypasses only Braceguard shields.
v18_red_smile.tell: Spark turns near-black 0x120A0D with a crimson 0xD01C34 grin, a faint crimson facing wedge, a crimson crescent per swing, an arrival ring + bossExecute sound and a RED SMILE HUD countdown, never violet — placeholder, A9 replaces.
v18_red_smile.sensitivities: No swing-rate floor (CL-42), so stacked attack speed is a readability/perf watch; the kaiju ends and pauses it (CL-44); a swing's chain no longer hops onto phased targets (A7b S12).

v18_riftline.geometry: Ordinary direct projectiles; pierce never carries a shot through the Carrier.
v18_riftline.targeting: Global pierce on every projectile built from the player's pierce count (pellets, echoes, fragments, shards, flower and turret shots, Backwash); not seeds, the icicle, returned shots or Shadow Edge.
v18_riftline.hitClass: +2 pierce (up to 3 bodies), each later body taking x0.75 of the previous (100 / 75 / 56%) via A6 rounding on one per-projectile threshold, plus +25% projectile range.
v18_riftline.bossClass: The falloff applies to boss hits too; no special treatment.
v18_riftline.sensitivities: Pierce carries the seeded lead shot past a boss, so Blackholes rarely overlap bosses (A6 watch 3, 7); under Polar Vortex T4 only the range survives, and CL-93 (A7a) stops offering it. CL-93 symmetric: owning this card closes Polar Vortex T4 (T1–T3 unaffected); owning Polar Vortex T4 stops it being offered.

v18_silver_skin.targeting: Self: every level-up arms one block (it doesn't stack), spent on the next hit past the i-frame and cooldown guards from a contact, enemy projectile or boss hazard.
v18_silver_skin.hitClass: Fully negates that one hit and grants 0.3s i-frames; the Unbroken projectile shield is checked first and spares it.
v18_silver_skin.tell: Silver (0xD6CCC2) ring, a blink and a small shake when spent; there is no armed-state indicator.
v18_silver_skin.sensitivities: Guard -> Void bridge: counts toward both ladders but requires Guard only (not a dual payoff like Red Smile); the bonus draw's dormant-bridge gap is fixed by CL-89 (A7a).

v20_deeproot.targeting: Self, while standing on cultivated ground.
v20_deeproot.hitClass: Stat only: +6 flat DEF while on the ground, counted as temporary DEF inside current DEF.
v20_deeproot.bossClass: n/a (flat DEF against every source, floor 1).
v20_deeproot.sensitivities: Growth -> Guard bridge: counts toward both ladders, requires Growth only; its DEF feeds Aegis spikes, Iron Bloom and the Unbroken snapshot; the bonus draw's dormant-bridge gap is fixed by CL-89 (A7a).

v20_panda.geometry: Panda systems = spectacle pass (Geo Ruling 6): arrival destinations resolve out of solids, a pinned victim is resolved outside the footprint every frame, rolls and bamboo rain ignore travel occlusion, and the kaiju strike target is line-of-sight checked from Spark; the body check, roll and kaiju-swipe knocks go through the one path-tested shove (A7b S14, CL-124a).
v20_panda.targeting: Mostly indifferent by design (random or nearest enemy); the samurai picks the healthiest mini-boss, then the boss, then the healthiest normal; the kaiju strike uses the shared priority target.
v20_panda.hitClass: Tiered panda acts (rolls, body checks, pins, aggro pulls, projectile-eating sits, healing naps, bamboo drops, a 5% samurai strike from T4) and at T5 a 10s kaiju every 45s (gun off, aura plus arc strikes, 85% DR inside the 90% ceiling, 0.7x move).
v20_panda.bossClass: Damage is BossClass-scaled on boss-class; the samurai deletes only below the execute threshold (else 14x ATK at 50%); the kaiju staggers bosses (2.6x ATK at 50%) and never deletes them.
v20_panda.killSource: summon (panda acts, samurai), capstone (kaiju strike), burst (kaiju aura, reward-only).
v20_panda.tell: Deliberately masked: '???' copy at every tier, punctuation-only tier names and a '???' HUD timer; 76pt pandas, a 3x kaiju with an orange ember aura, and a white samurai cut that belongs to no tree.
v20_panda.sensitivities: Secret card: never in the random pool or the bonus draw, 9.27% run eligibility (Review Mode forces it), first offer at levels 2-5 then every other level from the pick; neutral tag so it never feeds a synergy; T5 unlocks the earned panda skin at pick; kaiju tuning waits for the art pass.

v20_richsoil.geometry: Scales every zone's radius; membership as Terra.
v20_richsoil.targeting: Every cultivated zone, and Spark's ground regen.
v20_richsoil.hitClass: +2 HP on each 10s ground-regen tick, and every zone x1.22 radius on pick (on top of the usual +16% Growth expansion), within the 0.55 x arena-radius garden cap (A7b S14, CL-124d).
v20_richsoil.tell: The zone's swell animation on growth.
v20_richsoil.sensitivities: Its x1.22 respects the garden cap like every expansion since A7b S14 (CL-124d), so a later Growth pick never shrinks the garden back; at the cap the face's 'spreads wider' is silent, as it is for every Growth pick.

v20_seed_spore.geometry: Burst fragments are ordinary direct projectiles, blocked by the Carrier.
v20_seed_spore.targeting: Any main-chain projectile hit on an EnemyNode (pellets, echoes, fragments, flower and turret shots) seeds it; a seeded enemy's full-credit death bursts fragments radially.
v20_seed_spore.hitClass: The burst is 3 / 5 / 6 fragments at 30% shot damage, range 150pt x DeviceScale (x1.6 from T2), carrying standard projectile riders; T3 fragments re-seed once (generation 2), never deeper.
v20_seed_spore.bossClass: Bosses are never seeded (the boss hit path plants no seed); fragments hit bosses normally.
v20_seed_spore.tell: A spore puff (0xC9D96F / 0x5FCF62) at the death and pale-green seed fragments.
v20_seed_spore.sensitivities: Stacks with other on-death bursts (Chain Reaction, Null Bloom, Iceburst) in dense swarms.

v20_terra.geometry: Growth row: the root is placed through a ghost resolved out of solids and clamped inside the wall; the painted zone may overlap the Carrier, and membership is a plain circle test (actors stay out of the Carrier through the solid resolve, not the zone).
v20_terra.targeting: The player drags and releases to plant (a granted Terra auto-plants at Spark); every EnemyNode inside is slowed and Spark inside is nourished.
v20_terra.hitClass: Zone of 110pt x DeviceScale: enemies inside slowed 30%, 45% from Growth ×3 (x Chill slow potency), Spark regains 1 HP per 10s on the ground, every later Growth pick (tier-ups included) grows it 16% up to 0.55 x arena radius, 4 zones max.
v20_terra.bossClass: Mini-bosses are slowed at full; arena bosses are unaffected (not in the enemy list).
v20_terra.tell: Deep-green (0x174A2A) fill with a leaf-green (0x5FCF62) rim, Spark's nourished glow and a 'PLANT YOUR GROUND' placement beat, kept distinct from health-green.
v20_terra.sensitivities: The ground slow counts as 'slowed' for Chill's slow-conditioned amplifiers (Permafrost, Brittle Cold, Shatter) and Chill x3 doubles it to 60%; Terra + Guard is a positive emergent build (A5 watch 1, don't pre-nerf).

v20_thornsoil.geometry: Same zone membership as Terra (circle test; visual overlap allowed).
v20_thornsoil.targeting: Every EnemyNode standing on cultivated ground, once per 1s ground tick.
v20_thornsoil.hitClass: Raises ground damage to at least 6 per tick, never lowering Wildwood's 8 (bare takeDamage, no riders).
v20_thornsoil.bossClass: Mini-bosses take BossClass.scaledDamage (half); arena bosses never.
v20_thornsoil.tell: No dedicated tell; the zone is the tell.
v20_thornsoil.sensitivities: Order-proof (CL-97, A7b S4): with Wildwood the ground bites for 8 whichever is taken first.

v20_tree.geometry: The Tree stands at the largest zone's (valid) centre; T5 animals arc from the crown over geometry onto the mark; the lion pet walks straight at its prey and is resolved out of the Carrier after each step (A7b S14, CL-124b; no route-steering).
v20_tree.targeting: T5 every 4.5s the shared priority target measured from Spark (arena boss, then nearest mini-boss, then nearest normal, line-of-sight occluded); the lion hunts its own priority target.
v20_tree.hitClass: T1 garden +10%, T2 +15% move speed on the ground (garden +15%), T3 +3 HP per 4s on the ground, T4 garden +35%, T5 Nature Canon launches of about 150% ATK x per-animal effects (single strikes, AoE landings, knockback, a timed turret, poison clouds, a rare 10s lion pet).
v20_tree.bossClass: Animal damage is BossClass-scaled (50%) on mini-bosses and bosses; AoE landings include the boss.
v20_tree.killSource: summon (strikes, lion, turret needles), burst (AoE landings, reward-only), ground (skunk clouds).
v20_tree.tell: The Tree grows per tier; a green 'NATURE CANON' HUD countdown; per-animal art with emoji fallback.
v20_tree.sensitivities: Deer and boar shoves go through the one path-tested shove (A7b S14, CL-124a; the boar's charge itself passes as spectacle); garden growth is capped at 0.55 x arena radius; Growth is untouched in v2.1.

v20_vinewall.geometry: The edge-band push runs beside the void-well pull, before the frame's enemy geometry resolve, so a pushed body never sits inside the Carrier for a frame (A7b S14, the CL-77 precedent).
v20_vinewall.targeting: Non-mini-boss EnemyNodes in each zone's edge band (plus or minus 16% of radius), no hittability filter; T3 also hostile projectiles inside the zone.
v20_vinewall.hitClass: Control, no damage: a 65% slow and a 90pt/s outward shove (T2 x1.5); T3 deletes hostile projectiles inside the zone radius.
v20_vinewall.bossClass: Mini-bosses and arena bosses pass through (the zone-based fallback ruling).
v20_vinewall.tell: Deep bramble-green (0x2E6B3A) hedge ring on each zone.
v20_vinewall.sensitivities: Its 65% band slow feeds Chill's slow-conditioned amplifiers; T3 is a third hostile-projectile eraser alongside Void holes and the sitting panda.

v20_wildbloom.geometry: Flowers root at a random point within 85% of a random zone's radius with NO geometry validity check (a gap vs the section 3 rooted-object row); their shots are ordinary projectiles blocked by the Carrier.
v20_wildbloom.targeting: Each flower every 1.4s fires at the shared priority target from its own position within 240pt x DeviceScale, line-of-sight occluded (arena boss, then nearest mini-boss, then nearest normal).
v20_wildbloom.hitClass: Secondary projectile (no modifiers) at 25% of a normal shot through the standard hit chain (crit can roll), never a primary hit; one flower per tier, 3 max, permanent.
v20_wildbloom.bossClass: No BossClass scaling on flower shots; the boss is the preferred target.
v20_wildbloom.tell: A procedural flower (stem 0x2E6B3A, petals 0xC9D96F) that turns to aim and flashes on fire.
v20_wildbloom.sensitivities: A flower roots off the Carrier and inside the arena wall (A7b S14, CL-124c; the garden's centre is the fallback); flower shots pick up Riftline pierce and Erasure T2 styling.

v21_berserk.hitClass: Stat only: real fire rate +50% × missing-HP fraction, read live (barrier excluded).
v21_berserk.tell: HUD ATK SPD row shows the live rate.
v21_berserk.sensitivities: Pairs with Glass Engine's halved HP; no interval floor (CL-22 stress gate).

v21_bloodthirsty.geometry: Rides primary projectile and sweep hits (blocked by the Carrier); the Bleed status has no geometry.
v21_bloodthirsty.targeting: Survivors of primary hits only — primary pellets and the PV icicle roll 50%, and Red Smile sweep survivors bleed guaranteed; never shards, echoes, fragments, chains or summons.
v21_bloodthirsty.hitClass: Bleed: 10% effective ATK every 0.5s for 3s (6 ticks); a refresh restarts the duration without stacking or delaying the next tick, as a generation-0 lineage root.
v21_bloodthirsty.bossClass: Bosses and mini-bosses bleed at dotScale 50%, fraction-first; ticks ignore the Boss Mode DEF dial.
v21_bloodthirsty.killSource: statusTick (boss via onLethalHit with a bleed-channel context).
v21_bloodthirsty.tell: Three red 0xE0203A claw marks flaring each tick; bosses show a blood drop in the status row — placeholder, A9 replaces.
v21_bloodthirsty.sensitivities: Ticks sit on the ATK scale (1 at base) so they grow with ATK picks while shots don't; reward conditions mean bleeding BEFORE the killing damage (A4a gate ruling 2).

v21_electro_pulse.geometry: Instant player-to-target arc with no occlusion test, so it crosses the Carrier.
v21_electro_pulse.targeting: Charges only while the stick is deflected; every 3s strikes the nearest hittable enemy (A7b S12, CL-127a) within 220pt×DeviceScale, holding its charge until one is in range; enemies only.
v21_electro_pulse.hitClass: Secondary strike for 40% shot damage (min 1) that rolls Overload on a survivor and can start one Chain Lightning.
v21_electro_pulse.bossClass: Never targets the arena boss; mini-bosses unscaled.
v21_electro_pulse.tell: Yellow 0xFFE066 ring at Spark plus a jagged yellow arc to the target.
v21_electro_pulse.sensitivities: Inert in add-less boss fights (CL-95); 40% floors to 1 at base. A7b S13 (CL-123a): it strikes the nearest enemy it can see; with none in sight it stays charged.

v21_glacial_spikes.geometry: Strikes at the victim's own position on chilled ground, so no Carrier interaction beyond chilled-ground membership.
v21_glacial_spikes.targeting: Each enemy on chilled ground rolls 4%/s, and so does the arena boss when it stands on chilled ground (e.g. Ice Rink); one spike per 0.75s arena-wide, landing on the target after a 0.35s tell.
v21_glacial_spikes.hitClass: Secondary ground strike: executes normals, 20% max HP to mini-bosses, 3% max HP to the arena boss.
v21_glacial_spikes.bossClass: The 20%/3% values are final boss-class numbers with no further BossClass scaling; the boss hit takes the Boss Mode DEF dial and vulnerability.
v21_glacial_spikes.tell: A white/ice 0xCCF2FF ring closing over 0.35s, then an ice spike punching up — placeholder, A9 replaces.
v21_glacial_spikes.sensitivities: 'Elite' means mini-boss (CL-73); median first offer ~L24 in the A7a reachability walk.

v21_lightning_sentry.geometry: Coils are placed on valid ground (isBlocked check with a resolve fallback; T4 resolves a central anchor), but their shock arcs aren't occlusion-tested and cross the Carrier.
v21_lightning_sentry.targeting: Each coil shocks the nearest hittable enemy within 140pt×DeviceScale (T4 unlimited) every 0.8s (T4 0.4s), falling back to the arena boss only when no enemy is in range and the boss can be hit — never the vanished Faceted Lie (A7b S12, CL-127a).
v21_lightning_sentry.hitClass: Summon strike on the hit scale: 50% shot damage (T4 75%), min 1, with no crit, riders, Overload or chains.
v21_lightning_sentry.bossClass: The boss takes full damage (no BossClass scaling) with the Boss Mode DEF dial; mini-bosses unscaled.
v21_lightning_sentry.tell: Stubby dark mast with gold 0xF6D36B trim, pulsing yellow 0xFFE066 top and a faint range ring, plus a yellow jagged arc per shock — placeholder, A9 replaces.
v21_lightning_sentry.sensitivities: Both 50% and 75% floor to 1 at base; T1–T3 coils arc only to what they can see, the boss fallback included (A7b S13, CL-123a); the T4 Lightning Network stays arena-wide (CL-123b).

v21_sanguinarian.hitClass: Blood Barrier on each full-credit kill of max(1, floor(20% × finishing damage, overkill excluded)); the pool caps at 50% max HP, expires 4s after the last positive gain and absorbs before health (CL-5 order).
v21_sanguinarian.bossClass: A boss kill grants 20% of the HP its killing blow actually removed.
v21_sanguinarian.tell: Bone-white 0xEDE4D3 strip with a dark-red 0x8A1426 edge under the HP bar plus '+N'; a fully absorbed hit flashes only the strip (CL-21).
v21_sanguinarian.sensitivities: Barrier-only hits still reset Overcharge and fire reactive effects but can't consume a lethal rescue (CL-5); swarm near-immortality watch with Siphon.

v21_shadow_edge.geometry: A travel projectile: the swept segment test stops it at the Carrier (its 28pt body can sink about 10pt before stopping, cosmetic).
v21_shadow_edge.targeting: Every 7th qualifying primary volley (one that emitted a primary projectile) also fires one blade along that volley's aim.
v21_shadow_edge.hitClass: Secondary Void attack, named effects only: 125% of legacy shot damage (one rounding threshold, identical on every body), up to 3 bodies, Void affinity; no crit, riders, Anomaly, fear, meters, counters or spawns.
v21_shadow_edge.bossClass: Hits the arena boss with no Phase T2 DEF-dial penetration and no BossClass scaling.
v21_shadow_edge.tell: A long near-black (0x0E0B1C) crescent with a light-indigo rim; placeholder until A9.
v21_shadow_edge.sensitivities: Readability at volley 35 alongside a Blackhole (A6 watch 6); its range and speed ride Riftline and Long Shot; the counter runs from run start, so the first blade can arrive fewer than 7 volleys after the pick.

v21_void_horror.geometry: Flight is route-aware, clamped inside the wall, never steps toward Spark or into solid geometry, and slides along the Carrier face.
v21_void_horror.targeting: 8% roll on each primary hit the target survives (pellets, icicle, Red Smile sweeps); never returned shots, Shadow Edge, echoes, fragments, chains or DoTs.
v21_void_horror.hitClass: No damage: a fear state (own behaviour paused like a stun, runs away from Spark), then 2s of fear immunity from when it ends.
v21_void_horror.bossClass: Normals 0.5s, mini-bosses 0.25s, arena bosses immune; no roll on snowmen, airborne, trapped, stunned or frozen bodies, and a stronger control cancels fear.
v21_void_horror.tell: A white '!' and a quiver on the enemy; placeholder until A9.
v21_void_horror.sensitivities: Fear routing in constrained geometry (A6 watch 4); fears are rare with Phase T3 because few hits leave survivors.

void_1.geometry: Ordinary direct projectile: swept segment test, stops at the Carrier.
void_1.targeting: The gun's own primary pellets only (auto-aim, line-of-sight gated); never the Polar Vortex icicle, echoes, fragments, Shadow Edge or returned shots.
void_1.hitClass: Primary shot: launches at 40% speed, full speed after 0.6s; damage 150% -> 100% of the legacy (truncated) shot damage read at the hit, the A6 fraction rounded by chance on one threshold per projectile.
void_1.bossClass: No special treatment; the curve applies to boss hits too.
void_1.tell: Light-indigo (0x6688FF) stretched trail that shortens as the shot accelerates; placeholder until A9.
void_1.sensitivities: Warp feel vs payoff and probabilistic rounding (A6 watch 1-2); silenced by Polar Vortex T4's icicle, and CL-93 (A7a) stops offering it once T4 is owned; A7b S7–S8 extended CL-70-style rounding to the direct-hit block on its own threshold: the amplifiers (94a), then Overcharge and the resolved vulnerability (94b/94c). CL-93 symmetric: owning this card closes Polar Vortex T4 (T1–T3 unaffected); owning Polar Vortex T4 stops it being offered.

void_2.geometry: Opens where the pellet died (max range or the Carrier); the hole centre is resolved out of solids and clamped inside the wall; its pull runs before the frame's geometry resolve.
void_2.targeting: Spawned only by spent primary pellets (never on an enemy hit, never the icicle or secondaries); pulls live, hittable, non-snowman, non-airborne enemies inside it.
void_2.hitClass: No damage on its own: a 30pt (flat), 1s hole pulling 70pt/s that counts as a black hole for the Void synergies and Dead Circuit (provides .voidWell).
void_2.bossClass: Mini-bosses are pulled at BossClass.debuffScale (50%); arena bosses are never pulled.
void_2.killSource: n/a (ground via Dead Circuit or Singularity)
void_2.tell: Indigo (0x4466DD) ring over a deep-indigo (0x223366) fill with a light-indigo swirl, no dark core; placeholder until A9.
void_2.sensitivities: Opens a hole on every spent pellet, so the 4-live cap churns (Gravity Wells evicted first) and Dead Circuit rarely reaches 3 matter (A6 watch 5); silenced by Polar Vortex T4 (CL-93). CL-93 symmetric: owning this card closes Polar Vortex T4 (T1–T3 unaffected); owning Polar Vortex T4 stops it being offered.

void_3.targeting: Primary hits on survivors (gun pellets, the Polar Vortex icicle, each Red Smile sweep target) plus returned shots; never echoes, fragments, chains, Shadow Edge, wells or DoTs.
void_3.hitClass: Anomaly stacks (T3: 2 per hit) trigger at 4 and clear; T2 gives shot-class primary hits Void affinity (Braceguard bypass) plus the Boss Mode flat DEF-dial bypass, never Red Smile.
void_3.bossClass: Final values applied once (CL-74): normals erased, mini-bosses 20% max HP, arena bosses 3% max HP (post HP dial) through plain takeDamage (DEF dial applies), then a 2s no-stack cooldown for mini-bosses and bosses.
void_3.killSource: The triggering hit's own source (primary, capstone for the icicle, melee, returned).
void_3.tell: Up to 4 indigo pips under the enemy (dimmed while cooling) and a second pip row on the boss status tell; placeholder until A9.
void_3.sensitivities: At T1 a 1-4 HP normal usually dies before 4 stacks; T2 bites only on Braceguards and the DEF dial above 1.0; Anomaly + Singularity boss pressure is about 2%/s (A6 watch 3).

void_4.targeting: XP orbs only; health orbs stay non-magnetized.
void_4.hitClass: Stat only: XP orbs start their pull from 2x the current effective pickup radius (stacks with Keen Eye and Magnetic Core); collection is unchanged.
void_4.tell: No dedicated tell; orbs simply start drifting sooner.

syn:Bleed_3.hitClass: Amplifier: +25% vs bleeding targets — a fraction in the one unbiased direct-hit rounding on gun and sweep hits (CL-94, A7b S7), fraction-first on Burn and Bleed ticks of a bleeding target.
syn:Bleed_3.bossClass: Applies to a bleeding arena boss too (CL-32), unscaled.
syn:Bleed_3.sensitivities: The direct arm now moves 1-damage hits too (a mean of 1.25; A7b S7).

syn:Bleed_5.hitClass: Direct-hit amplifier: ×2 below 25% HP on gun and sweep hits; one ×2 where Execution Protocol overlaps.
syn:Bleed_5.bossClass: Applies to arena bosses and mini-bosses (the boss last quarter).
syn:Bleed_5.sensitivities: Boss last-quarter melt watch; never applies to DoTs, chains or capstone damage.

syn:Bleed_7.hitClass: Stat only: heal 1 HP on each full-credit kill of an already-bleeding enemy.
syn:Bleed_7.bossClass: A bleeding boss kill heals once (CL-29).
syn:Bleed_7.sensitivities: Stacks with Siphon; the starting value is 1 (source comment says 'test 2').

syn:Chill_3.hitClass: Stat only: slowPotencyMultiplier ×2 (effectiveSlow capped at 80%) for Frost Touch, the Glacial Drift trail and Windchill slows; global slows are unaffected.
syn:Chill_3.bossClass: Applies to mini-bosses in full; arena bosses take none of these slows.
syn:Chill_3.tell: None beyond the usual slow tint.
syn:Chill_3.sensitivities: Shares the name 'Frostbite' with Polar Vortex T5's vulnerability — a Lyra naming call (§B6 noticed list).

syn:Chill_5.geometry: Rides projectile and sweep hits, so the carrier is blocked by the Carrier.
syn:Chill_5.targeting: Any enemy struck by a player projectile or Red Smile sweep while isSlowed with personal + global slow ≥ 40% (30% with Chill ×7), counting the same hit's Frost Touch.
syn:Chill_5.hitClass: 20% chance to shatter (no fragments): a normal enemy is executed outright, ending the hit before its damage, Bleed, Whiteout and Chain Lightning; an elite takes the elite chunk, 20% of max HP through the Anomaly helper, and if it survives takes the rest of the hit (A7b S10, CL-99/118).
syn:Chill_5.bossClass: Mini-bosses take the elite chunk instead of dying, scaled by their vulnerability (a Frostbitten one loses 30%; a melting snowman 40% with the melt's own 20%); arena bosses are immune (the boss hit paths lack it).
syn:Chill_5.killSource: The striking hit's own source: primary, fragment, capstone (icicle) or melee; a gun kill keeps the shot's Iceburst generation (CL-118c).
syn:Chill_5.tell: None dedicated — a normal enemy simply dies; an elite just takes the chunk.
syn:Chill_5.sensitivities: No rate limit (CL-118b; a device watch, since every Frost Touch hit on a slowed elite may roll); the gun's Shatter exit charges Apex and Erasure once, as the sweep's does (CL-118c); the tuning lives in GameConfig.Chill (CL-118d); a pure global slow never qualifies (needs isSlowed).

syn:Chill_7.targeting: Every enemy's movement, mini-bosses included; arena bosses don't read the global slow.
syn:Chill_7.hitClass: +25% global enemy slow (combined slow capped at 80%) and the Shatter threshold drops 40% → 30%.
syn:Chill_7.sensitivities: Lights Permafrost for every enemy (Q-C5); the global slow alone never marks an enemy isSlowed for Shatter or Iceburst. A7b: CL-108 ruled — arena bosses stay immune to the Ice Rink / Absolute Zero slow (the runtime already was); since S10 the copy says so (G2-4 detail 'non-boss enemies', G2-3 line 'Non-boss foes slow').

syn:Fire_3.geometry: Enemy-to-enemy spread by distance only, so it passes the Carrier.
syn:Fire_3.targeting: Every non-burning enemy within a fixed 30pt (37.5pt with Fire ×5) of any burning enemy, checked each frame.
syn:Fire_3.hitClass: Applies Burn at 50% of Kindle's DPS as `.kindleSpread`: ignites or reactivates dormant stacks, never adds one.
syn:Fire_3.bossClass: Enemies only — bosses never catch or emit it; mini-bosses burn at dotScale 50%.
syn:Fire_3.tell: Orange Burn rim on the newly ignited enemy.
syn:Fire_3.sensitivities: Tesla-only burning enemies also spread Kindle-strength Burn; spread to/from bosses sits on the A7 list; inert in add-less boss fights (CL-95).

syn:Fire_5.hitClass: Stat only: burnDPS ×2 (Kindle 0.5 → 1.0 per stack), Burn duration 2s → 4s, spread radius ×1.25.
syn:Fire_5.bossClass: Flows through Burn's dotScale 50% on boss-class.
syn:Fire_5.sensitivities: Copy omits the 2s → 4s duration (CL-101); multiplies whatever burnDPS exists at that moment (Kindle is always owned first).

syn:Fire_7.geometry: Positionless arena-wide tick; no geometry interaction.
syn:Fire_7.targeting: Every normal enemy in the arena, mini-bosses included; never the arena boss.
syn:Fire_7.hitClass: Direct damage tick of 0.5 DPS × Fire bucket paid in whole points — not a Burn status, so no Relay Burn, spread, pips, Crucible or Open Wounds.
syn:Fire_7.bossClass: Arena bosses excluded; mini-bosses take it unscaled.
syn:Fire_7.killSource: sweep (reward-only: the frame-top prune credits the deaths).
syn:Fire_7.sensitivities: Copy 'Every enemy in the arena is burning' overpromises — CL-100 copy-only fix via the CL-101 wording table (A7a).

syn:Growth_3.hitClass: terraSlow +0.15: the ground slow goes from 30% to 45% (× Chill slow potency, capped at 80%).
syn:Growth_3.sensitivities: With Chill ×3's doubled potency the ground slow reaches the 80% cap (60% without Rootbound); wired in A7b (CL-96), the copy unchanged.

syn:Growth_5.hitClass: +2 HP on each 10s ground-regen tick (1 -> 3, or 5 with Rich Soil); the tick rate is unchanged.
syn:Growth_5.tell: The HP bar's heal flash on each tick.
syn:Growth_5.sensitivities: CL-101 copy: 'mends you faster' -> it heals more per tick.

syn:Growth_7.targeting: Every EnemyNode on cultivated ground, once per 1s ground tick.
syn:Growth_7.hitClass: Sets ground damage to max(current, 8) per tick, even without Thornsoil.
syn:Growth_7.bossClass: Mini-bosses take half (BossClass.scaledDamage); arena bosses never.
syn:Growth_7.tell: The synergy reveal modal; the zone is the in-world tell.
syn:Growth_7.sensitivities: Taking Thornsoil afterwards keeps it at 8 (CL-97).

syn:Guard_3.geometry: Aura: no occlusion test, so a hostile behind the Carrier still counts.
syn:Guard_3.targeting: Counts hittable, non-snowman enemies whose surface is within 150pt x DeviceScale, plus the arena boss as one, once per frame after DoTs.
syn:Guard_3.hitClass: Percentage DR of 9% per contributor, 10 max (90%), in the pipeline's ironhide slot inside the shared 90% ceiling.
syn:Guard_3.bossClass: An arena boss or a mini-boss counts as one contributor.
syn:Guard_3.tell: A faint steel ring around Spark whose opacity tracks the current %, hidden under the kaiju; placeholder until A9.
syn:Guard_3.sensitivities: Ironhide + Aegis at the 90% ceiling (A5 watch 2); Unstable Core self-damage bypasses it.

syn:Guard_5.targeting: Whatever just landed a valid damaging contact on Spark.
syn:Guard_5.hitClass: Retaliation of 1.50x the contact's raw pre-mitigation damage (before the Boss Mode ATK dial); never from invulnerable-ignored, Silver-Skin- or Phase-Skin-absorbed contacts.
syn:Guard_5.bossClass: Arena bosses take it once through BossClass.damageScale (50%) before truncation, with the DEF dial; mini-bosses and normals take the full 1.50x.
syn:Guard_5.sensitivities: The Slag Titan reflects about 30 per touch at 5:00 (A5 watch 5); Harden/Aegis bounces create fresh contacts that re-trigger it; CL-101 copy: add that bosses take half.

syn:Guard_7.targeting: Self: the next lethal hit once Brace is spent; the shield blocks any EnemyProjectileNode (never area strikes).
syn:Guard_7.hitClass: Lethal rescue #2 opening 10s of full invulnerability on its own timer (self-damage included) plus a bonus multiplier of DEF / ATK snapped at the rescue; a persistent shield blocks one hostile projectile and rearms in 6s; collision radius x0.85.
syn:Guard_7.bossClass: Source-agnostic; boss projectile volleys are blockable, boss area strikes are not.
syn:Guard_7.tell: Steel (0xB8B2A6) shield on Spark's RIGHT with a gold (0xFFD98A) rim when ready and dim while rearming; the window adds a gold rim, an 'UNBROKEN' HUD countdown and a '+N ATK' pop; placeholder until A9.
syn:Guard_7.sensitivities: Capstone-level power that must stay readable (A5 watch 6); Fortify at rescue time feeds the snapshot.

syn:Shock_3.hitClass: Stat only: +1 Chain Lightning jump (T4 + Chain Current = 5 jumps, 6 enemies).
syn:Shock_3.bossClass: Chains never reach the arena boss, so no boss effect.
syn:Shock_3.tell: One more bolt in the chain.
syn:Shock_3.sensitivities: Copy drifted from the approved '1 additional enemy' wording (CL-101).

syn:Shock_5.geometry: Player-centred radius, so it passes the Carrier (Ruling 1 names Tesla).
syn:Shock_5.targeting: Every enemy within a fixed 50pt of Spark (not DeviceScale-scaled), each frame.
syn:Shock_5.hitClass: Flat 0.3 DPS on the Burn channel (source `.other`): no Fire bonus, never multiplied by stacks, and the stronger of it and Kindle's Burn applies, not the sum.
syn:Shock_5.bossClass: Enemies only — never the arena boss; unscaled on mini-bosses (CL-17 halves only Kindle's share).
syn:Shock_5.tell: No field visual; affected enemies show the orange Burn rim.
syn:Shock_5.sensitivities: Tesla-burned enemies count as burning, feeding Relay Burn and Spreading Flame and holding dormant Crucible stacks, but never extend Kindle's Burn (A4a timer fix).

syn:Shock_7.geometry: Its pellets are ordinary projectiles blocked by the Carrier, aimed by the LOS-checked auto-aim.
syn:Shock_7.targeting: Every 3rd gun volley (Red Smile swings never count) fires the normal pellet count + 2 (3 at base; 4 / 5 / 6 with Scatter T1 / T2 / T3) in the standard V fan along the auto-aim direction.
syn:Shock_7.hitClass: Primary pellets: every shot modifier and hit rider applies, and each hit can start a chain.
syn:Shock_7.tell: The spread volley's V fan only; no dedicated FX.
syn:Shock_7.sensitivities: Never fewer pellets than a normal volley (CL-98). Under Polar Vortex T4 the extra pellets condense into more icicles (every 3rd pellet), e.g. Scatter T3 goes from about 3.7 to 4.7 icicles per 3 volleys.

syn:Void_3.geometry: Opens where the seeded lead shot stopped (enemy, boss, Carrier or max range), resolved out of solids and clamped inside the wall; absorption and impair are area tests with no line of sight.
syn:Void_3.targeting: Every 5th qualifying primary volley seeds its lead projectile; every live player hole then absorbs hostile EnemyProjectileNodes inside it (8 each) and slows enemies inside by 40%.
syn:Void_3.hitClass: Blackhole preset of 60pt x DeviceScale for 2.5s; absorbed shots are deleted (or held with x5) and count as Dead Circuit matter; 4 live holes max, oldest Gravity Well evicted first.
syn:Void_3.bossClass: Arena bosses are never pulled or slowed and their projectile volleys are absorbable (area strikes are not); mini-bosses are pulled at 50% and slowed at full.
syn:Void_3.tell: Indigo ring with a near-black (0x05060F) core and a light-indigo swirl, with an absorb spark; placeholder until A9.
syn:Void_3.sensitivities: Shot 35 = Blackhole + blade (A6 watch 6); four holes plus absorbed and returned shots is the perf watch (A6 watch 5); an empty Glacial volley doesn't count.

syn:Void_5.geometry: The trap is an area test; returned shots need an exact line of sight from the hole to their target and then travel as ordinary projectiles (Carrier-blocked).
syn:Void_5.targeting: Traps live, hittable, non-snowman, non-airborne enemies entering any live hole; each absorbed shot returns 0.15s later at the nearest hittable enemy or boss the hole can see, or is discarded.
syn:Void_5.hitClass: The trap is a hold (no chase, attack or fire) that never writes stun or freeze; a returned shot is a secondary with named effects only: 1x legacy shot damage, Void affinity, Phase T2 DEF-dial penetration and Anomaly, with no crit, riders, counters or re-absorption.
syn:Void_5.bossClass: Normals are held until the hole ends, mini-bosses for half its remaining life (then that hole can't retake them), arena bosses never; returned shots can hit the boss.
