syn:Void_5.tell: An indigo tether ring on trapped enemies; returned shots are white with an indigo rim; placeholder until A9.
syn:Void_5.sensitivities: Repulse can't displace trapped bodies (A6-Q1), but other shoves can detach and release them; an ending or evicted hole returns its held shots at once or discards them.

syn:Void_7.geometry: Area test with no line of sight; a normal's terminal hold may outlive its hole by up to 2s.
syn:Void_7.targeting: Trapped enemies, and the arena boss while its body overlaps any live hole.
syn:Void_7.hitClass: Decomposition (fraction-first, skips the flat DEF dial): normals 50% max HP/s in a terminal hold of up to 2s, mini-bosses 8%/s capped at 20% per trap, the arena boss 1% max HP/s that never stacks across holes.

crosscutting.title: Taxonomy
body: Seven affinity trees (Fire, Chill, Shock, Bleed, Guard, Void, Growth) plus **Neutral**, the palette's constant (not a tree), plus one **secret** card outside the taxonomy (Panda).

Each tree has exactly one **signature** (its thesis card: the mandatory first pick, which grants the tree's `…Unlocked` capability) and exactly one designated **capstone** (a 5-tier ladder). Ordinary cards may have up to 4 tiers (canon amended Sep 15: T4 allowed, one capstone per tree).

Tier percentages are totals; an attack-speed % is a firing-rate increase. Synergies (×3/×5/×7) count DISTINCT cards per tree on first pick only; levelling a card never feeds a synergy. A bridge (dual-tag) card counts toward both trees.

crosscutting.title: Drafting and eligibility
body: **One offer rule for every draw** (CL-89): the level-up spread, reroll, the Boss Mode random opener and the +1 Card bonus all use `UpgradeManager.isOfferable`. A card is offered only if it isn't maxed; its `requires` are held; its next tier's `tierRequires` are held; nothing the run holds is in its `blockedBy`; it isn't secret; its colour (and a bridge's second colour) is in the run's palette; and it isn't a capstone while another capstone is in progress.

**Signature opening:** while the run holds no signature, spreads offer only signatures (one per active tree); a reroll prefers unseen signatures. **Gateway pity:** an unowned active signature unseen for 3 level-ups takes the front slot (one claimant per draw, longest-waited).
**Capstone focus and finish:** an in-progress capstone locks every other capstone out and is guaranteed a slot every other level; the +1 Card never offers it.
**Palette:** 5 colours + Neutral per run, one banned colour honoured, at least one colour always left out; Growth unlocks at Arena 5.

**Enabler edges (A7a):** Gouge → `critSource` → Hemorrhage (CL-91); Polar Vortex → `polarVortex` → Frost Touch T3 (CL-92); Polar Vortex T4 and the five pellet cards (Warp Shot, Gravity Well, Mirror Edge, Fracture Shot, Riftline) are mutually exclusive, both ways (CL-93, symmetric): T4 grants `glacialCondensation`, which blocks the pellet cards, and each pellet card grants `pelletEffect`, which closes T4; Glacial Drift → Glacial Spikes; Whiteout → Ice Rink (Glacial Drift T5); Gravity Well / Null Bloom → `voidWell` → Dead Circuit; Red Smile needs both the Bleed and Void signatures.

**Proof:** `tools/catalog-harness` walks the real draw — every draftable card offered and maxed from a fresh run on a full save and a new save — and checks the offer rule across both draws with an independent oracle.

**Acquisition-time eligibility (A7a corrective F1/F2):** a pick is re-checked when it is TAKEN (`UpgradeManager.acquire` / `isSelectable`), and after the Extra Pick's first card the rest of the table is revalidated — stale cards drop out, nothing replaces them. A card taken during a level-up is never offered again at another tier in that level-up (spread, reroll, +1 Card or a scheduled seat). A capstone whose next tier is closed is stalled: no guarantee, no lockout.

crosscutting.title: Damage, hits and kills
body: **Player damage pipeline** (CL-5, closure table §D): percentage reductions multiply under a 90% combined ceiling (the kaiju included); flat DEF applies after; lethal rescues go Brace first, then Unbroken Core, never both on one event.

**Gun damage is a whole number**, usually 1: a shot deals `max(1, Int(damageMultiplier))`. A6's new fractions use unbiased probabilistic rounding (CL-70). A7b S7 (CL-94, 94a) extends it to the direct-hit amplifiers: after the integer steps (base, crit, Lucky Break, executes, then Forge offense), Permafrost, Brittle Cold and Open Wounds multiply as fractions and the hit rounds ONCE, unbiased, on its own threshold (independent of CL-70's), minimum 1. A7b S8 (94b/94c) adds Overcharge (split out of the shot's base, never below its old floor) and the target's resolved vulnerability to the same block; the hit enters the target through a direct entry that doesn't apply the vulnerability again, while DoTs and every other source keep the in-node rounding. Overkill and Chain Lightning read the same block without the vulnerability.

**Hit classes:** a *primary shot* (the gun's pellet, or the Polar Vortex icicle that replaces it) triggers on-hit riders and advances volley counters; a *primary hit* (anything that 'hits' as a primary, including Red Smile's sweeps) stacks Anomaly, rolls Void Horror and rolls Bloodthirsty but never advances shot counters (CL-39/72/85); a *secondary* (echoes, fragments, shards, returned shots, Shadow Edge) carries named effects only (CL-4/75); a *DoT tick* (Burn, Bleed) takes the 50% boss-class scale and ignores the Boss Mode DEF dial (CL-17/18).

**Kill credit** goes through one chokepoint (`KillSource`); boss kills go through `onLethalHit`. Some sources (`.burst`, `.sweep`) are reward-only and feed no on-kill effects (Unstable Core, Everglow, Static Crown, Chain Reaction, False Opening) — a closeout-audit item.

**Hittability** (CL-40, A7b S12 CL-126/127a): these targeters pick only bodies that can be hit — alive and tangible, never a phased PaneStalker or the vanished Faceted Lie: the gun's auto-aim (the Skybeam-lassoed prey included), Chain Lightning, the Electro Pulse, Sentry coils and their boss fallback, Relay Burn arcs and Red Smile (the named set; others — the Apex bat, Erasure's normal lurch, Unstable Core, Skybeam's lasso and strike — still filter on dying alone). The gun falls through to the next visible hittable target, else holds fire.

crosscutting.title: Boss-class treatment
body: 'Elite' means **mini-boss** in code. `GameConfig.BossClass` carries 50% levers for capstone damage (`damageScale`), capstone debuffs (`debuffScale`) and DoTs (`dotScale`) on mini-bosses and arena bosses.

Target-class values that are already boss-specific apply **once**, never through a second lever: Anomaly (mini-boss 20% max HP, boss 3%), Overload stuns (0.25s / 0.5s), Glacial Spikes, Singularity (1%/s).

Arena bosses are stun-immune in v2.1 and are never trapped, feared or turned into snowmen. Wave spawns pause while a boss lives, and the Boss Mode gauntlet has no wave spawns — only boss-summoned adds (the Slag Titan's minions, the Marchwarden's muster) — so enemy-only effects go quiet between them (CL-95). Since A7b S11 Erasure's lurch falls back to a lone, hittable boss and Unstable Core costs nothing with nothing in range (CL-119/120); the Everglow pulse stays boss-excluded (CL-121); wider Boss Mode eligibility is banked for v2.2 (CL-122).

crosscutting.title: Geometry (Arena 6 reconciliation, §3 and Rulings 5–6)
body: Ordinary direct projectiles (player and enemy) are **blocked** by the Carrier; auto-aim excludes targets without line of sight. Red Smile's sweep needs an exact clear segment per target.
**Pass:** player-centred auras, global/positionless effects, falling and sky-strike effects, Void beams, and supernatural tethers (the Skybeam lasso, Iron Maiden T5).

**Never inside solids:** wells, flowers, rooted objects and ground zones can't originate inside; knockback, pulls and teleports resolve out of the footprint; Panda may cross geometry as spectacle but never leaves persistent state inside it.

Gaps found while writing this packet are ruled for A7b (CL-109): Carrier geometry is respected unless a mechanic has an explicit terrain exemption. Known cases: chain and arc hops, coil shocks and point bursts with no Carrier test; Skybeam T3 homing without the LOS check; Wildbloom flowers and the Tree lion ending inside the Carrier; Vine Wall's one-frame intrusion; Rich Soil skipping the garden radius cap. **Fixed in A7b S13–S14:** arcs and hops (Chain Lightning, Relay Burn, the Electro Pulse, Sentry T1–T3 and the coils' boss fallback) take the nearest target they can see on the exact segment, else none (CL-123a), with the T4 Lightning Network arena-wide (CL-123b) and point bursts exempt under Ruling 1 (CL-123c); Skybeam homing uses the gun's line-of-sight test; every instant knock goes through one path-tested shove (CL-124a); flowers root off the Carrier and inside the wall, the lion resolves each step, the Vine Wall pushes before the resolve, and Rich Soil respects the garden cap (CL-124b–d).

crosscutting.title: Colour and feel language
body: **Purple = danger** (ranged enemies, enemy projectiles). Player-owned Void effects in the world are **indigo** (CL-86). Magnet orbs are blue; health orbs are never magnetized.
Every new mechanic ships with a readable procedural tell; art polish follows in A9 (with Lyra).
